snippet.title: Welcome to My Slime Garden!
snippet.description:
Here is the latest trailer! Come check out my FREE chao garden inspired rogulite game!
We are going to Too Many Games, hope to see you there!

Game is out for free now with weekly updates on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3332460/My_Slime_Garden/

Don't forget to hop over here for feature requests!
https://discord.gg/QkJtBRpN26

And the reddit page!
https://www.reddit.com/r/MySlimeGarden/
